en.title: The Stardust Bookstore and the Galactic Lighthouse
en.premise: In a corner of the universe where stardust drifts like sand, lies a mysterious place known as 'The Stardust Bookstore.' Here, the precious memories of others sleep, preserved within the pages of books. Lulu, a small squirrel and the shop's proprietor, holds a vital role: delivering memories that have lost their way. But when a stark white book stripped of its light arrives, Lulu sets out on a journey toward the 'Old Lighthouse' at the edge of the cosmos to return it to its rightful owner.

zh.title: 星屑古书店与银河灯塔
zh.premise: 在星砂飞舞的宇宙一隅，坐落着一个名为“星屑古书店”的神奇场所。在那里，人们珍视的回忆化作一册册书籍，静静地沉睡着。店主是一只名叫露露的小松鼠，她承担着一项重要的工作——为迷失的回忆寻回归途。某一天，一本失去了光泽的纯白之书送到了店里，为了将它归还给主人，露露决定踏上旅程，前往位于宇宙尽头的“古老灯塔”。
